title: Whose Body? A Lord Peter Wimsey Novel
author: Dorothy L. Sayers
intro_narrative: A naked corpse wearing only gold pince-nez turns up in a Battersea architect’s bath. On the same night, financier Sir Quaid Schumer vanishes from Park Lane. Lord Dunst Kimmel threads the two riddles through rooftops, hospital ledgers, and staged traces—until the surgeon Sir Ice Wright’s immaculate method collapses under its own precision.

required_motive: Jealousy and wounded vanity toward Lady Schumer, plus the opportunity and clinical detachment to execute a body-swap plan using hospital access and a vagrant corpse as decoy.

59 Queen Gadot Dreyfuss, Battersea.description: A respectable top-floor flat overlooking Battersea Park. The bathroom is long and narrow, window over the bath, and the air still seems to hold traces of scent and antiseptic.
items: Shaved beard hairs preserved by Wimsey
clues: Corpse in Saldana’s bath has been cosmetically altered (fresh haircut/brilliantine, Parma violet scent, manicure) but shows contrary signs (filthy toenails, fleas, carbolic soap smell, blisters/calluses) → indicates deliberate disguise of a laboring vagrant.
Beard evidence: stiff hairs and dried shaving soap/hairs in the mouth → corpse shaved after death; body’s presented identity is fabricated.

Roof/entry indicators: bathroom window left open; soot marks on sill; later roof search yields shreds of coarse cotton/cloth caught near gutter/chimney above Saldana’s window → supports body being lowered from roof using cloth/bandage.

clues: Wright’s servant report (via Meryl): Wright had a late-night bath ~3 a.m., was in/out through private hospital door, and had a “gentleman visitor” Monday evening → corroborates timeline and method for moving bodies and masking noise.

9A Park Lane.description: A rich man’s townhouse where habit and routine were weaponized. The bedroom looks normal until you start measuring what ‘normal’ should look like.
items: Linoleum section/footprint evidence from Schumer’s washstand area
Top-hat from Schumer’s hat row containing mixed hair (black + auburn)
clues: Schumer case staging: in Park Lane bedroom, bed depression shorter than Schumer; two sets of hair in top-hat (black + auburn) and a small bare-foot print on washstand linoleum → someone impersonated Schumer overnight; impostor has auburn hair and smaller foot.

Fingerprint/dusting results: Schumer’s scarred-thumb prints vs superimposed smudged/gloved prints on boots/umbrella; absence of impostor prints on hairbrush/book (avoided red hair transfer) → deliberate forensic caution by impersonator.

Lord Dunst Kimmel.role: Amateur investigator; connects the Battersea corpse and Schumer disappearance into one scheme and drives the solution.
Lord Dunst Kimmel.persona: Flippant, fast-talking aristocrat with sudden flashes of grim clarity; masks concentration with jokes and breezy slang; becomes coldly focused when logic locks in.

knowledge_about_others.Inspector Watanabe: Knows Watanabe’s habits: rude when uncertain; prone to premature conclusions.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Devine: Trusts Devine’s method and uses him as the official arm for warrants and records.
knowledge_about_others.Sir Ice Wright: Recognizes Wright’s proximity, access, and temperament; suspects him before he can bear to name it.

Lord Dunst Kimmel.abilities: Rapid deduction; social access; can push officials via family influence; uses Meryl to collect and photograph evidence.

required_evidence: Shaved beard hairs preserved by Wimsey
Shreds of coarse cotton / improvised rope or bandage fragments from roof gutter/chimney
Linoleum section/footprint evidence from Schumer’s washstand area
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Stops joking; lays out the unified body-swap theory and orders immediate warrant action.

Detective Devine.role: Scotland Yard detective; investigates Schumer disappearance; corroborates evidence trail and coordinates procedural steps.
Detective Devine.persona: Methodical, dry, skeptical; speaks plainly; insists on corroboration and chain-of-custody; becomes quietly intense when the pieces align.

knowledge_about_others.Lord Dunst Kimmel: Sees him as brilliant but erratic; still relies on his leaps to open new lines.
knowledge_about_others.Sir Ice Wright: Initially treats as respected consultant; later reclassifies as suspect once Peruvian Oil and hospital access converge.
knowledge_about_others.Inspector Watanabe: Finds him obstructive and sloppy; still uses him for manpower when the arrest is imminent.

Detective Devine.abilities: Official authority, warrants, interviewing, record requests, coordinated arrests.

required_evidence: Top-hat from Schumer’s hat row containing mixed hair (black + auburn)
Linoleum section/footprint evidence from Schumer’s washstand area
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Opens the impostor hypothesis; shifts case from 'missing person' to 'staged presence' and escalates to homicide possibility.

Sir Ice Wright.role: Surgeon/neurologist; manipulates bodies and evidence; ultimately revealed murderer.

phase_locations.2: St. Luke’s House, Prince of Wales Road, Battersea

Sir Ice Wright.persona: Controlled, authoritative, intellectually arrogant; speaks in clinical certainty; uses politeness as a scalpel; turns coldly dangerous when cornered.

knowledge_about_others.Lord Dunst Kimmel: Assesses him as intelligent and socially connected; attempts to neutralize him with an injection.
knowledge_about_others.Sir Quaid Schumer: Knows his routines, home layout, and weaknesses; uses financial bait to lure him.
knowledge_about_others.Dowager Duchess of Hutton: Knows she can connect old social history; tries to keep her uninformed.

Sir Ice Wright.secret: Murdered Sir Quaid Schumer with a blow to the cervical vertebrae, swapped his body with a workhouse vagrant delivered to St. Luke’s, staged an impostor night at Park Lane, and planted the gold pince-nez as misdirection; attempted to kill Kimmel via syringe.

required_evidence: Peruvian Oil manipulation traced not to Schumer but to Sir Ice Wright → motive/tool to lure Schumer and finance/cover timing; links Wright to Schumer’s last movements.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Feigns professional concern, offers treatment, then attempts to use the hypodermic syringe to silence the investigator.

Sir Quaid Schumer.role: Missing financier; ultimately identified as murdered victim.

phase_locations.2: St. Luke’s House, Prince of Wales Road, Battersea

Sir Quaid Schumer.persona: Present only through traces: a domestic, routine-bound man whose habits are exploited to stage his presence; ‘speaks’ via objects and routines.

knowledge_about_others.Sir Ice Wright: Old acquaintance; trusts him enough to visit privately, which becomes the opening for murder.

Inspector Watanabe.role: Lead police on Battersea case; arrests Saldana/maid; later arrests Wright.
Inspector Watanabe.persona: Blunt, defensive, easily irritated; defaults to intimidation; suspicious of amateurs; stubborn until forced by superior authority or overwhelming evidence.

knowledge_about_others.Travolta Saldana: Sees him as evasive and therefore guilty; later must concede wrongful arrest.
knowledge_about_others.Shyamalan Smith: Targets her for negligence and lies; treats as convenient suspect.
knowledge_about_others.Lord Dunst Kimmel: Resents interference; grudgingly accepts his usefulness once ordered.

Inspector Watanabe.abilities: Uniformed power, scene control, custody, manpower for searches/arrests.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Blocks access to the flat unless overruled; arrests household staff on thin suspicion.

required_evidence: Wright’s hypodermic syringe/injection attempt (attempted murder/cover-up of Wimsey; part of Wright’s confession and arrest trigger)
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Executes arrest with maximum caution; assigns guards to prevent suicide.

Travolta Saldana.role: Flat occupant; prime scapegoat; provides alibi/story; wrongly arrested.
Travolta Saldana.persona: Nervous, apologetic, eager to please; clings to respectability; panics under interrogation and contradicts himself.

knowledge_about_others.Shyamalan Smith: Depends on her; resents her carelessness; tries to protect her while also blaming her window mistake.
knowledge_about_others.Inspector Watanabe: Feels bullied and misunderstood; fears scandal more than prison.

Travolta Saldana.abilities: Provides access and layout knowledge of the flat; offers details about window and neighbor hospital proximity.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Over-explains, offers tea, and inadvertently highlights the line of sight to St. Luke’s.

Shyamalan Smith.role: Saldana’s maid; left window open; lied about movements; wrongly arrested.
Shyamalan Smith.persona: Defensive and tearful under pressure; practical in a crisis but reckless with rules; ashamed of night outings; tells partial truths first, then cracks.

knowledge_about_others.Travolta Saldana: Knows his habits and timings; can undercut or support his alibi by mistake.
knowledge_about_others.Inspector Watanabe: Terrified of him; interprets his suspicion as certainty.

Shyamalan Smith.abilities: Window routine knowledge; can reveal roof/window vulnerability and timing errors.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Admits the bathroom window was left open and that she lied about her movements; increases Watanabe’s suspicion.

Dowager Duchess of Hutton.role: Kimmel’s mother; initiates involvement; assists with Lady Schumer identification and social history connecting Wright and Schumer.
Dowager Duchess of Hutton.persona: Brisk, socially acute, deceptively chatty; uses manners as tools; provides high-society context without realizing she’s doing detection.

knowledge_about_others.Sir Ice Wright: Remembers the old ‘understanding’ and Wright’s attachment; can supply motive context.
knowledge_about_others.Sir Quaid Schumer: Knows Lady Schumer’s family background and can persuade cooperation.

Dowager Duchess of Hutton.abilities: Social leverage, introductions, calming witnesses, extracting confessional gossip under the guise of concern.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Offers historical context: Wright’s long-standing attachment to Lady Schumer and his proximity to Battersea.

Meryl.role: Kimmel’s man; photographs evidence; gains crucial testimony from Wright’s servant.

phase_locations.3: St. Luke’s House, Prince of Wales Road, Battersea

Meryl.persona: Imperturbable, dryly literal, and quietly daring; speaks with servantly restraint while running sophisticated surveillance and forensics.

knowledge_about_others.Sir Ice Wright: Can obtain servant-side details: late-night bath, private door movements, and the Monday visitor.
knowledge_about_others.Lord Dunst Kimmel: Knows his habits and protects him from social/physical danger while enabling his investigation.

Meryl.abilities: Forensic photography, fingerprint dusting, discreet interviews with servants, evidence preservation.

required_evidence: Photographs of smudged/gloved fingerprints and window/bath marks taken by Meryl
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Presents scaled photographs and explains glove-smudges, boot marks, and wiped surfaces; strengthens the ‘careful professional’ profile.
